bibl.title: Lorenzo: il figlio 'dimenticato' di Girolamo Vitelli.
bibl.seg: Anna Di Giglio & Rosario Pintaudi, Lorenzo: il figlio 'dimenticato' di Girolamo Vitelli.
bibl.note: Six children were born from the marriage between Girolamo Vitelli and Marianna Tàppari. Five of them are known to history: Vittorio, Camillo, Maria, Serafino, Teresa; but, little Lorenzo was 'forgotten' - he died in 1881 just a few months old.
